entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Hi... yes, I'm calling about my VeloBand GPS Tracker. I... I think I need to return it. It's all a bit confusing.
I can certainly look into that for you. To get started, could I please have your name and the order number?
Yes, it's Mark Shapiro. The order number is... um... VF77812-C.

Thank you, Mark. I have your account pulled up. I see you received the VeloBand about 40 days ago. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

Oh, no, it works fine! I just... I think I just changed my mind. It was a bit of an impulse buy, and honestly, I just don't use it like I thought I would. The website was... well, I'm not sure I understood the policy.
I see. So it's not meeting your expectations?
It's not that, it's just... me. I don't use it. I was even looking into options for resale online, but that seems like a lot of work. Can't you just help me?
Of course, Mark. Let me just pull up our current return guidelines for you. One moment.
Okay, thank you for your patience. I've just checked the policy here in our system. It looks like you're well within the 90-day return window.
Oh! Really? I thought I had missed it. That's a relief.

Not at all. Since you received it 40 days ago, we can definitely process this return for a full refund. I've just sent a pre-paid return label to the email address on file. Just print it out, attach it to the original box, and drop it off at any post office.
Wow, that was so much easier than I thought it would be. Thank you so much, Diana.
You're very welcome, Mark. Once we receive the item, your refund will be processed within 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again!
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
